defect: pulse toggle crosses into the destination through one receiving stage
rationale: The source pulse is converted to a level toggle, but the asynchronous level is captured by only one destination-domain register before functional edge detection.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: dst_level is the only synchroniser stage and is also used by the pulse XOR, so the crossing has one stage and exposes the metastable flop to logic.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the source pulse-to-toggle conversion and destination edge detector, reduced the primitive dependency, and exposed the destination capture logic in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Removed the second destination synchronizer stage so src_level is captured directly into dst_level.
